Curves

Click the line to add a point. Drag points to reshape. Double-click a point to remove it. Drag the bottom-left point up to lift blacks.

Save project

A project file keeps all your layers, tracks, clips and settings so you can open it later and keep editing. Choose what to include.

Transition between clips

The first clip overlaps the second, so one blends into the next and you never see a black screen. Pick a look and a length.

1.0

Content-aware scale

Resize the picture while keeping the important parts, like people and objects, from stretching. It removes or adds the least noticeable lines of pixels. All layers are resized together.

Tip: select the people or objects first, then tick Protect. Large changes take longer.

Resize & crop

Resize image resamples every layer to the new size. Resize canvas keeps the pixels the same size and crops or extends the document around the anchor.

Perspective layer

Drag the four corner handles to warp the active layer into perspective. The preview uses the layer's visible pixels. Apply bakes the warp into the layer; Undo restores it.

Content-aware fill

Fills the selected area using the picture around it, so objects disappear without leaving a patch. The result goes on a new layer, so you can hide or undo it.
